description: Defines an API client class 'OrangeHrmApiClient' for interacting with the OrangeHRM API, including authentication and request execution methods.

classes.name: OrangeHrmApiClient
classes.description: A sealed class that provides methods to authenticate with and interact with the OrangeHRM API, managing session cookies and executing HTTP requests.

methods.name: CreateClient
methods.description: Creates and configures a RestSharp client with stored cookies and API base URL.

methods.name: AuthenticateAsAdmin
methods.description: Performs authentication with the API using admin credentials and stores session cookies.

methods.name: ExecuteAuthed
methods.description: Executes an authenticated request using stored cookies, after admin authentication has been performed.
